item.title: Melissa Gilbert Breaks Silence, Returns to Work as Husband Faces Child Sex Abuse Case
item.description: Earlier this month, a grand jury indicted the actor on four counts of criminal sexual contact of a child. He had previously been arrested in January and initially held without bail

item.title: THADDEUS McCOTTER: Big Tech’s And Automakers’ Dangerous Ploy To Kill AM Radio
item.description: The march of time and technology has taken its toll on Americans’ unity. Big Tech and automakers want to stop putting AM radios in their vehicles. Instead, they want to install audio systems provided by – you guessed it – Big Tech companies, such as Google, Amazon, and Apple, etc.

item.title: Felony Charges Loom as States Move to Shield Churches From Protest Disruptions
item.description: The legislative push follows a demonstration at Cities Church in St. Paul, Minnesota, where activists entered the sanctuary chanting "ICE out."

item.title: Trump Slams Newsom’s Global Deals as ‘Inappropriate’ Power Play
item.description: "The U.K.’s got enough trouble without getting involved with Gavin Newscum."

item.title: DAN HAYWORTH: We’re Winning The War On Trans Ideology — But Those Gains Could Still Be Reversed
item.description: Radical gender ideology suffered another setback when the American Medical Association and American Society of Plastic Surgeons declared their opposition to sex-change surgeries for minors. But just because conservatives are winning right now doesn’t mean we can get complacent.

item.title: Thune Forces Showdown Vote on Voter ID Bill
item.description: Thune framed the vote as a political test, saying it would force Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer and Democratic lawmakers to publicly defend their stance on requiring voter ID and proof of citizenship to register.

item.title: Anderson Cooper Signs Off From ’60 Minutes’
item.description: "For nearly twenty years, I've been able to balance my jobs at CNN and CBS, but I have little kids now and I want to spend as much time with them as possible."

item.title: AOC Roasted by Left and Right After Foreign Policy Flubs Go Viral
item.description: "Whoever convinced AOC that she had successfully completed her tutoring and was now ready to give book reports about foreign policy in public really should look for another line of work."

item.title: KURT MICELI: The Silence Has Been Broken. Will The Rest Of Organized Medicine Listen?
item.description: The American Society of Plastic Surgeons (ASPS) did something rare in organized medicine: it changed course. In its new position statement on gender surgery for minors, ASPS acknowledged that its understanding has shifted given recent, comprehensive evidence reviews.

item.title: Rink Horror: Family Dispute Turns Deadly During High School Hockey Game
item.description: Investigators believe the violence stemmed from a family dispute that escalated into a murder-suicide.
